VBO:0201039.shortDescription: Pomapoo is a name for a Pomeranian–Poodle cross.

sources.title: Kari Trotsky, D.V.M. — Levi’s reported DNA ancestry
sources.evidence: Fresh actual veterinarian-keeper memoir reports cheek-swab DNA testing and half Pomeranian/half Poodle results, then calls Levi Pomapoo. Supports the two-parent identity; test not independently inspected and percentages are not generalized to every Pomapoo.
